name: Edel Blume
source:
The time is the middle ages, the place a remote region of Europe, in a small village surrounded by mountains.
There is a village that is ruled by a heretic noble, in an impassable region.

The protagonist is a young nun named Mary who doesn't know her parents, she can't remember her childhood and was raised at the church.
Getting closer to her 16th birthday she starts having nightmares every night.
They seem like memories of a person that is herself, but not herself, she can't remember the contents very well but she can tell they are dreams about that 'other self' doing something frightening.

And so, on the night of a full moon the noble Gerald who lives in a castle at the summit of a mountain comes to the village with a request.
On the day of Mary's 16th birthday he want's her to offer herself up to him in marriage.

From that day, strange things start happening in the village...

[Translated from the [url=http://www.otomate.jp/home/game/spec/?hard=ps2&title=edel]official site[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在中世纪欧洲的偏远边境，一座群山环抱、与世隔绝的小村庄里。
统治着这座闭塞村落的，是一位被视作异端的贵族。

主人公玛丽是一名年轻的修女。她自幼在教堂长大，既不知晓亲生父母是谁，也失去了童年时代的记忆。
随着十六岁生日一天天临近，她开始夜夜噩梦缠身。
梦境仿佛属于某个“既是自己、却又并非自己”的人；醒来后她虽记不清具体细节，却隐约察觉梦中的“另一个自己”正在犯下某种骇人听闻的罪行。

就在一个满月之夜，居住在山顶古堡中的贵族杰拉尔德来到村中，提出了一项要求：
他要玛丽在年满十六岁当天嫁给自己，作为新娘献身于他。

自那一天起，村子里便接二连三地发生起诡异的事件……

[译自[url=http://www.otomate.jp/home/game/spec/?hard=ps2&title=edel]官方网站[/url]]
